label: Buy and hold, risk-scaled
desc: A constant forecast: long every market at its vol-scaled size.
config:
carver_s04_buy_hold:
  asset_classes:
  - crypto
  - futures
  - fx
  universe_filters:
  - type: ListingFilter
  - type: PrimaryOnly
  - type: AdvFilter
    params:
      min_adv: 50000000
      lookback: 63
  vol_estimator:
    type: CarverBlend
    params:
      span: 32
  vol_normalizer:
    type: Standard
    params:
      target_vol: 0.1
      vol_floor: 0.05
  asset_allocator:
    type: EqualWeight
    params: {}
  model_gearing:
    type: VolCorr
    params:
      target_vol: 0.1
      asset_vol_target: 0.1
      corr_lookback: 504
      signal_lookback: 0
      leverage_cap: 5.0
  cost_model:
    type: FixedBPS
    params:
      cost_bps: 2.0
  signals:
  - type: CarverSignal
    weight: 1.0
    params:
      rules:
      - type: Constant
      fdm: 1.0
